metadata.purpose: Historical defect knowledge for Agentic QE retrieval, failure analysis, regression assessment and impact analysis
metadata.governance: Historical information must not override the current approved requirement baseline

defects.title: Customer created successfully but cannot be retrieved
defects.requirement_statement: A successfully created customer must be retrievable using the generated customer ID
defects.observed_behavior: POST returned successful creation response but subsequent GET returned 404
defects.expected_behavior: Created customer must be persisted and retrievable
defects.root_cause: Customer persistence operation was not committed before the create transaction completed
defects.historical_learning: HTTP 201 alone is insufficient evidence of successful customer creation
defects.agent_guidance: When create returns success, verify business outcome through subsequent retrieval

defects.title: Unsupported country accepted during customer creation
defects.requirement_statement: Country must be one of the supported countries
defects.observed_behavior: Customer was created with unsupported country value
defects.expected_behavior: Request must be rejected and no customer must be created
defects.root_cause: Country validation was missing from the create request validation path
defects.historical_learning: Negative validation tests must verify both rejection and absence of unintended data modification
defects.agent_guidance: For invalid input, validate the response and verify that persistent customer data remains unchanged

defects.title: Duplicate customer was created
defects.requirement_statement: Duplicate customerName and country combinations must not create another customer
defects.observed_behavior: A second customer record was created with the same customerName and country
defects.expected_behavior: Duplicate request must be rejected and existing customer must remain unchanged
defects.root_cause: Duplicate validation was performed only against a non-unique customer name field
defects.resolution: Implemented duplicate validation using customerName and country combination
defects.historical_learning: Duplicate validation must use the complete approved business uniqueness rule
defects.agent_guidance: When duplicate behavior is tested, verify both rejection and preservation of the original record

defects.title: Developer role was incorrectly allowed to update customers
defects.requirement_statement: Developer role is authorized for Create and Retrieve but not Update
defects.observed_behavior: Authenticated Developer successfully updated an existing customer
defects.expected_behavior: Developer update request must be rejected as unauthorized
defects.root_cause: Authorization matrix did not correctly enforce operation-level permissions
defects.historical_learning: Authentication and authorization must be validated separately
defects.agent_guidance: Do not treat successful authentication as permission to perform every operation

defects.title: Country validation was case-sensitive
defects.observed_behavior: Values such as india and INDIA were incorrectly rejected
defects.expected_behavior: Supported country values must be accepted regardless of letter case
defects.root_cause: Country comparison used case-sensitive string matching
defects.historical_learning: Validation normalization rules must be included in regression coverage
defects.agent_guidance: When a validation rule is case-insensitive, generate representative lower-case, upper-case and mixed-case variants

defects.title: Invalid optional email accepted
defects.requirement_statement: Optional email must be valid when supplied
defects.expected_behavior: Malformed email values must be rejected
defects.root_cause: Optional fields were excluded from validation when mandatory-field validation passed
defects.resolution: Added validation for optional fields when supplied
defects.historical_learning: Optional does not mean unvalidated; optional fields require validation whenever provided
defects.agent_guidance: Generate both omitted and supplied-valid/supplied-invalid variants for optional fields

defects.title: Successful response returned without required customer information
defects.requirement_statement: Successful create response must contain generated customer ID and relevant customer information
defects.observed_behavior: HTTP success response was returned but customer ID was missing from response body
defects.expected_behavior: Response must contain the generated customer ID and required customer information
defects.root_cause: Response schema validation was not implemented
defects.resolution: Added response-body schema and business-field validation
defects.historical_learning: HTTP status alone does not establish API correctness
defects.agent_guidance: Validate status code, response schema, business fields and downstream business outcome

defects.title: API response exceeded eight-second performance threshold
defects.requirement_statement: API response time must be less than eight seconds under normal test conditions
defects.observed_behavior: Average response time exceeded the approved eight-second threshold
defects.expected_behavior: Response time must remain below eight seconds under normal test conditions
defects.root_cause: Slow downstream persistence dependency caused excessive request latency
defects.resolution: Optimized persistence interaction and connection handling
defects.historical_learning: Performance failures require timing evidence and dependency analysis rather than functional response inspection alone
defects.agent_guidance: Capture response time and relevant dependency evidence before classifying performance failure

agent_usage_rules.rule: Historical defects may support RCA and regression prioritization but must not override the current approved requirement baseline
A historical defect is evidence of what happened previously, not proof that the same defect currently exists
Historical defects should be correlated with current execution evidence before recommending RCA conclusions
If current evidence contradicts historical behavior, preserve both observations and investigate the difference
Historical defects may increase regression priority when their affected requirements or code paths are changed
Historical artifacts must never be deleted merely because the associated defect is resolved
